title: Akiyama Mizuki — Rooftop Friendship〔Part2〕Side Story (Part 2)

rows.Line: Mizuki's Room

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Hmhmhmmmm〜♪
This goes here and... Perfect.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <K, I added an effect to the chorus in the vid for some added cuteness. You check it out too, Yuki! There, sent♪>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Got it. Playing it now...>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah, it's nice.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I think so too. Kind of flashy, but not in a bad way.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <See? I'll keep going with this then!>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line:
<Sure. Hey, Amia.
You seem cheerful.
Things going well for you?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Yeah. I guess they have been since the School Festival♪>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Huh, you're all here already?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hi, Enanan! Did you just get back from school?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <No, I didn't have school today. I was eating dinner.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<I see. Anyway, great timing!
I was just telling everyone about the School Festival.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Oh yeah, that was at our school.
I'm guessing you went to it then?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I did! A classmate called me that morning and asked me to come. The plan was for us to stick together...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <But stuff happened, and then I met your brother!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <What? You met Akito?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Oh, he told me that he met a friend of mine or something... It was you all along.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<Sigh... I should've gone too.
I could've snapped some good school life pics.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <I just totally forgot about it and slept until evening.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Doesn't every class have to prepare a show or some other display for the festival? Was your night class exempt?>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Um... No, but I didn't help with anything...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Neither did I.
But...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Poor Enanan... I had a friend who invited me along anyway, and she didn't... Boohoo...>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <Excuse me? What are you trying to start?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hahaha. Sorry.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Next time we should all go.
Together as N25.>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <What?>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Us too? Why?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Because it's fun to walk around and look at all the stuff everyone put together. You would've all had a good time. Even you, K.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <When I was there, I was trying to imagine how it would've been if you guys came with.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <There were so many different shows and stalls, like a theater performance, a haunted house, yakisoba, cotton candy...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<The second years' show was so crazy too.
Well, you know, in a good way!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<It was dramatic, but the plot was nuts!
Impossible to follow, but really funny.
I was wondering how Yuki would've reacted.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And how K might've reacted to the haunted house. I mean, it was seriously spooky!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Enanan would've been taking selfies against the cotton candy stall with all their cute animal designs!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <I kept thinking how much more fun it would've been if we'd all gone together.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <And you know what! There was is night festival after that for Kamiyama students only too...>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <Amia, I don't know if I've ever seen you this excited.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <I was just thinking that too. The School Festival must've been really fun.>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
<If it really was all that,
maybe I'll show up next year.>

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: <Yeah. I'm interested too.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Seriously?! What about you, Yuki?!>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I could go if I have the time to...>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<That's a promise, right♪
Next time, we're all going!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Hey, it just dawned on me that we could go to Yuki's School Festival! When's your school doing theirs?>

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: <I'll tell you next year.>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
<Okay, don't forget!
Haha. I can't wait!>

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: <You just went to a School Festival, and you still want more?>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: <Why not? Also, waiting for something exciting is part of the fun too!>

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: (Next year, I'll make sure to help with my class' prep.)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
(So when the N25 crew shows up,
I'll present it to them with pride♪)
